checkDefinitions.meaning: Every listed file exists at the exact case-sensitive relative path.
All MOD, sample tag, example ID, date, state, province, and asset placeholders are replaced deliberately.
PDX files use UTF-8 without BOM; localisation follows its language header and project encoding policy.
Definitions, callers, GFX names, asset paths, and localisation keys agree across every file in the resource.
Version-sensitive fields are rechecked against the target build and exact enabled dependencies.
Language header is correct and portable templates use key: "Text" without a numeric suffix.
Registered names, consumer tokens, extensions, and on-disk path case match.
The copied kit passes the base validator as one cross-file unit.
The customized kit receives the smallest relevant isolated in-game test after user consent.
